The inscription finish is critical: letters and numerals are INCISED / INTAGLIO into marble, their recessed floors and inward-sloping walls painted with warm deep satin antique GOLD paint. Subtle rubbed brush texture INSIDE the carving only. Strong readable contrast, visible inward-cut bevel and inner shadow. Preserve stone depth; not raised metal letters, not a flat digital overlay, not pale-gray carving, not illegible distressing.
